created_prompt: Julie has a popular cooking channel with 1.2 million followers where she published cooking videos for quick healthy recipes. She would like to grow her channel into a full time profession over the next three years. The goals are to grow the online channel and to publish a cookbook.  The challenges are that she works four days a week at her unrelated job, so she has limited time. She also has a limited budget.  The last question to answer is whether traditional or self-publishing is the best avenue for a publishing a cookbook.  Can you devise a three year plan to help Julie reach her goals?
